verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a centralized rule system for defining and enforcing engineering standards, with automatic enforcement across every repository. Rule Miner can generate rules from PR history, and agents can retrieve the applicable rules, so the reviewer clearly enforces team-defined standards. The evidence consists only of short doc snippets that never describe how rules are authored. missing for 10: documentation of rule format (natural-language vs AST patterns), support for linking external style guides, independent or hands-on corroboration of rule enforcement.
